name: teamflow-fyp
description: TeamFlow - WhatsApp-integrated AI-powered group task management system for university students

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "npm.cmd --prefix backend run dev" "npm.cmd --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
